title: Problem onboarding aaps 4.0 dev app not responding
body:
Build 4.0.0 dev

Just updates yesterday from master 3.4.2.2 . I notice it look some time to import or alter boluses. I don't remember eraxtly anymore. 

After that I noticed graphs not updating correctly, and it was appearing laggy. 

I didn't give it too much attention, since I thought to gave the app some time to settle. 

After one or two hours after setting up the app (at about 23.00 on 10 May), the app crashed and didn't recover. Screen just Hung and nothing happened. Also clearing cache didn't help. 

After that I delete all data, did a new onboarding with importing settings from 3.4.2.2 and a full ns sync, and the app seems running smoothly now. With the right graphs updating.
